stem.text: Two forces, each of magnitude $F$, act in opposite directions on a rod.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod with pivot P at its centre, an upward force F at the left end and a downward force F at the right end, with dimension arrows labelled d on each side of P.

stem.text: Each force acts on the rod at a distance $d$ from the pivot P.
What is the torque of this couple about P?
